name: LC-39A Fixed Service Structure & Crew Access Arm
summary: Historic Apollo/Shuttle launch tower refurbished by SpaceX for Crew Dragon astronaut boarding and Falcon 9/Heavy pad services at KSC LC-39A.
function: Provides crew boarding access via the 54 m Crew Access Arm and White Room, emergency egress baskets/slidewire, and pad telemetry/power distribution.
materials: Structural steel open-truss tower clad in dark weather panels, aluminum/steel Crew Access Arm bridge, and pressurized clean-room White Room interface.

specs.label: Tower Height
specs.source: NASA KSC LC-39A Fixed Service Structure spec (~265 ft)

specs.label: Crew Access Arm Level
specs.source: SpaceX / NASA Commercial Crew LC-39A arm height (~177 ft)

specs.label: Site Availability
specs.source: NASA KSC / SpaceX launch complex inventory

history: Originally constructed for Apollo Saturn V and modified for Space Shuttle launches, SpaceX leased LC-39A in 2014 and added the sleek black-and-white Crew Access Arm in 2018 for Crew Dragon.
